messages:
maria_support: FYI — customer FinTrack reported a breaking issue: our JSON-mode output is intermittently invalid and crashes their downstream parser. They hit this in prod on Dedicated (us-west).

maria_support: Customer notes: works for a while, then responses sometimes contain garbage past the JSON block (trailing tokens), or unescaped newlines inside strings.

jake_csm: They said it started after a model roll 2 days ago. Request IDs: r-98123, r-98156. Pipeline keeps failing their ingestion. They want an ETA and a quick mitigation.

sam_eng: Can you paste one of the raw responses? Need to confirm pattern (trailing text vs truncated JSON).

maria_support: Pasting sanitized response from r-98123: 
```
{
  "transaction_id": "ft-42",
  "amount": 1200,
  "notes": "Customer requested expedited shipping
Please confirm"
}
Unrelated debug: cache_miss=true
```
Notice the JSON closed then there is a plaintext line "Unrelated debug: cache_miss=true" appended.

anya_sre: Looks like our runtime sometimes appends logs to stream if streaming is enabled and the model emits outside the JSON fence. Are they using streaming?

maria_support: They are using the normal sync endpoint (no streaming) but with json_mode=strict in the body.

sam_eng: Repro steps I want: exact request payload, model name, and whether they pass a `stop` sequence. Also need the model kernel version.

jake_csm: Request they sent (redacted): 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\n    "model": "rw-instruct-2.0",\n    "json_mode": "strict",\n    "prompt": "extract transaction as JSON:\n\n{{text}}",\n    "max_tokens": 300\n  }'\n```
They did not set a `stop` param.

sam_eng: Ok, likely root cause: model sometimes emits assistant commentary after the JSON block when not constrained. Without an explicit stop the runtime returns everything the model produced. On hosted we strip some streaming artifacts; Dedicated customers can hit edge cases with kernel/model combos.

anya_sre: Short-term mitigation: suggest customer set an explicit stop token right after the JSON close, or use `response_format: {"type":"json_schema",...}` (our structured schema enforcement) so the runtime will attempt to validate/repair. Also suggest `max_tokens` tight bound and `temperature: 0`.

maria_support: Customer will try the stop fallback. Any internal follow-up? They asked for SLA credit if this breaks their production pipeline.

sam_eng: I'll open INC-2319 and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml to investigate model kernel change introduced in last roll. ETA for triage: 4 hours. Will update here.

eng-bot: Incident INC-2319 created by sam_eng. Priority: P2. Assignees: eng-runtime, eng-ml.

jake_csm: Customer is threatening to cut over to a homegrown post-processor. Need a neutral comms line: offer workaround + 24h hotfix window or temporary API-level post-processing (we can enable strict schema enforcement for them).

anya_sre: For Dedicated, we can toggle `automatic_log_strip=true` on their instance configuration to prevent runtime logs being appended to responses. That requires a restart — downtime ~30s.

maria_support: Sharing proposed customer message: "We recommend enabling schema enforcement or adding an explicit stop sequence. We're investigating an internal model rollout and will provide a targeted fix within 24h. We'll offer a one-week credit if this caused ingestion failures." Thoughts?

sam_eng: sounds good. Add: please collect a failing example (full response + request headers) and upload to the INC ticket. Also include the model kernel version (from /v1/instances/{id}/meta).

jake_csm: Sent proposed message to customer, they're ok to try stop token + schema enforcement. They asked for the rollout ID that might have triggered this.

sam_eng: Rollout ID for the recent change: rollout-2026-03-10-ker1. Eng-runtime will check diffs (tokenization/streaming hooks).

anya_sre: Next steps: (1) Customer tries stop/schema workaround (2) eng-runtime triages INC-2319, collects core dump and model logs for r-98123/r-98156 (3) If reproducer found, push a micro-rollout to Dedicated nodes and notify CSM.

maria_support: Marking this thread for follow-up. I will update after customer tests. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Reminder — please update INC-2319 with artifacts within 6h to avoid escalation to P1.

maria_support: Thanks — will do.
